payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP arrays c and cod of size n+1 count paths of weight i; c uses all edges 1..k, cod uses edges < d; answer = c[n] - cod[n].
payload.rationale: The solution counts combinations of edge weights that sum to n using a standard 1D DP (coin change style). It computes total paths minus paths with all edges < d, directly enforcing the 'at least one edge ≥ d' condition.
